Eligibility

Who can apply for a home loan?

A Papua New Guinea citizen, or an overseas resident living and working in PNG
Aged between 18 and 60
A regular salary and at least 2 years of employment

What to bring

  • Completed home loan application form
  • Three copies of your latest pay slips
  • Employment confirmation letter or contract
  • Letter of offer from the seller showing the price
  • Acceptance of the offer by the seller
  • Copy of the title deed from the seller
  • Proof the property is on state-leased land
  • Evidence of your equity contribution
  • Statements of outstanding debts
  • Last six months of bank statements from other banks
  • Latest property valuation
  • Last six months' loan statement if refinancing

Questions

Loan FAQs

How do I apply?+

Start online through the NBCL website, or visit any branch and a loan specialist will guide you through your application.

Can I borrow to build on customary land?+

No. Home loans and investment property loans are for property on state-leased land.

Can I use my superannuation for my equity?+

Yes. A digital confirmation or letter from your super fund confirming your housing advance can be used as evidence of equity.

Are the calculator results guaranteed?+

No. They are estimates to help you plan. Your actual rate and repayments depend on your application, credit approval and current terms. Using the calculator does not affect your credit record.

Ready to apply for a loan?

Apply online in minutes, or visit any branch. Bring your ID and latest payslips, and our lending specialists will be ready to guide you.
